visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man wearing a blue cap with 'TAIPEI' text and a young woman with dark hair sit together in an indoor living room. They hold a large, colorful display box labeled 'TOP TOY' featuring Hello Kitty imagery in teddy pajamas. (2) The man excitedly gestures as they open the main display box to reveal twelve smaller blind boxes inside; the background shows home curtains and soft indoor lighting. (3) The woman opens a silver foil inner bag, pulling out a small, plush pink Hello Kitty keychain with a heart-shaped pink clip on top. (4) The man opens a second bag, revealing a brown teddy-themed Hello Kitty plush, holding it close to the camera lens to show its soft texture and red bow. (5) A third person, a woman in a white hoodie, appears on the right side of the frame as they display a mint-green version of the plush toy. (6) The second woman holds a light blue Hello Kitty plush, rotating it to show the white hood and the pink bow detail to the viewer. (7) The first woman holds a purple plush keychain, smiling and bringing it close to her face, highlighting the small purple heart on the toy's chest. (8) A bright yellow Hello Kitty plush wearing a golden-threaded hood is shown in a tight close-up shot, emphasizing the shiny gold heart on its stomach. (9) All three characters hold up their various unboxed plushies simultaneously, waving them toward the camera in a lively group pose. (10) The video cuts to a final top-down view of all six plushies (pink, brown, green, blue, purple, yellow) arranged neatly on a white tabletop surface.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The man introduces the unboxing session with energetic vocal delivery; an upbeat, acoustic piano-based BGM begins with a clear rhythmic pulse. (2) A sharp, high-pitched vocal exclamation from the girl creates a momentary peak in arousal as the sound of thick cardboard moving is heard. (3) Continuous plastic rustling sounds dominate the mid-frequency range as they unwrap the individual blind boxes. (4) A bright 'Pop' sound effect triggers as the first plush is shown; the girl’s voice rises in pitch to express excitement for the color pink. (5) Fast foil tearing sounds punctuate the transition between each plush reveal; the BGM remains steady with light synth pads in the background. (6) Overlapping female voices create a dense vocal texture, with frequent laughter and short, high-arousal phrases like 'So cute!'. (7) 'Ding' and 'Whoosh' transition sound effects are interspersed between revelations, marking each new product's appearance on screen. (8) The man’s voice maintains a mid-pitch, authoritative but friendly tone, often finishing the girl's sentences as they describe the plush features. (9) The audio event density reaches its peak as all three speakers chatter simultaneously over the sound of plushies being handled. (10) The BGM enters a short outro phrase and fades out as the man asks a final question to the audience; the sound of items being placed on a table creates soft thud transients.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to promote and showcase a specific collection of Hello Kitty blind box plushies from TOP TOY, targeting collectors and Sanrio fans through high-energy interaction and visual presentation.
